snapshot_scope: Only repositories returned by the connected GitHub list/affiliation actions in this run; not a claim about all GitHub repositories or private ChatGPT conversations.

enumeration.limitation: The connected list actions did not expose pushed_at/updated_at or latest commit timestamps. Recency-based ordering was therefore unavailable; batch order uses project relevance.

scan_cursor.cursor_rule: Advance only after each bounded batch has a dated report; do not infer that remaining repositories were scanned.
